title: Lie-Detector Probe Benchmark on Open-Weights Activations

original_idea.body: # Lie-Detector Probe Benchmark on Open-Weights Activations. Train a logistic-regression probe on hidden states to classify lies, benchmark generalization across lie types. Beginner-feasible linear algebra.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reproducible lie-detection probe baseline supports deception monitoring; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Logistic-regression probe on activations; genuinely beginner-feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused probe pipeline + cross-type generalization; some breadth across lie types.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Community baseline tool on open weights; labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Activation extraction + linear probe on small model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Heavily overlaps gen-3137 and existing Liars' Bench probing; baseline largely addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Linear lie-detection probing on these datasets is largely covered.
